lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਭਾਗ ਅਭਾਗ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਨ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa abhaag abhaag hai jin ke tin saadhoo dhoor na peejai ||
lines.translation: Those who have terrible luck and bad fortune do not drink in the water which washes the dust of the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਜਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa tisanaa jalat jalat nahee boojhahi da(n)d dharam raai kaa deejai ||6||
lines.translation: The burning fire of their desires is not extinguished; they are beaten and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਜਗੵ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀਏ ਹਿਵੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਗਾਲਿ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh teerath barat jagy pu(n)n keee hivai gaal gaal tan chheejai ||
lines.translation: You may visit all the sacred shrines, observe fasts and sacred feasts, give generously in charity and waste away the body, melting it in the snow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਤੋਲ ਤੁਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: atulaa tol raam naam hai guramat ko pujai na tol tuleejai ||7||
lines.translation: The weight of the Lord's Name is unweighable, according to the Guru's Teachings; nothing can equal its weight. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੂ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tav gun braham braham too jaanahi jan naanak saran pareejai ||
lines.translation: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues. Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੀਨ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: too jal nidh meen ham tere kar kirapaa sa(n)g rakheejai ||8||3||
lines.translation: You are the Ocean of water, and I am Your fish. Please be kind, and keep me always with You. ||8||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamaa ram raamo pooj kareejai ||
lines.translation: I worship and adore the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan arap dharau sabh aagai ras guramat giaan driReejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I surrender my mind and body, and place everything before Him; following the Guru's Teachings, spiritual wisdom is implanted within me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਨਿਤ ਚੁਨਿ ਚੁਨਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham naam gun saakh tarovar nit chun chun pooj kareejai ||
lines.translation: God's Name is the tree, and His Glorious Virtues are the branches. Picking and gathering up the fruit, I worship Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aatam deu deu hai aatam ras laagai pooj kareejai ||1||
lines.translation: The soul is divine; divine is the soul. Worship Him with love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਿਚਰਿ ਬਿਚਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bibek budh sabh jag mahi niramal bichar bichar ras peejai ||
lines.translation: One of keen intellect and precise understanding is immaculate in all this world. In thoughtful consideration, he drinks in the sublime essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad padaarath paaiaa satigur kau ihu man deejai ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the treasure is found; dedicate this mind to the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਤਿ ਹੀਰੋ ਨੀਕੋ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਬਿਧੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramolak at heero neeko heerai heer bidheejai ||
lines.translation: Priceless and utterly sublime is the Diamond of the Lord. This Diamond pierces the diamond of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਪਰਖਿ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man motee saal hai gurasabadee jit heeraa parakh laeejai ||3||
lines.translation: The mind becomes the jeweller, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; it appraises the Diamond of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਊਚੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੀਪ ਪਲਾਸ ਖਾਇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)gat sa(n)t sa(n)g lag ooche jiu peep palaas khaai leejai ||
lines.translation: Attaching oneself to the Society of the Saints, one is exalted and uplifted, as the palaas tree is absorbed by the peepal tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh nar mahi praanee ootam hovai raam naamai baas baseejai ||4||
lines.translation: That mortal being is supreme among all people, who is perfumed by the fragrance of the Lord's Name. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਖਾ ਹਰੀ ਜੜੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal niramal karam bahu keene nit saakhaa haree jaReejai ||
lines.translation: One who continually acts in goodness and immaculate purity, sprouts green branches in great abundance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਹਕਾਰ ਬਾਸੁ ਜਗਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: dharam phul phal gur giaan driRaaiaa bahakaar baas jag deejai ||5||
lines.translation: The Guru has taught me that Dharmic faith is the flower, and spiritual wisdom is the fruit; this fragrance permeates the world. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek jot eko man vasiaa sabh braham drisat ik keejai ||
lines.translation: The One, the Light of the One, abides within my mind; God, the One, is seen in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਪਸਰੇ ਸਭ ਚਰਨ ਤਲੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aatam raam sabh ekai hai pasare sabh charan tale sir deejai ||6||
lines.translation: The One Lord, the Supreme Soul, is spread out everywhere; all place their heads beneath His Feet. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਕਟੇ ਨਰ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਾਕ ਵਢੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa nakate nar dekhahu tin ghas ghas naak vadheejai ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, people look like criminals with their noses cut off; bit by bit, their noses are cut off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: saakat nar aha(n)kaaree kaheeahi bin naavai dhrig jeeveejai ||7||
lines.translation: The faithless cynics are called egotistical; without the Name, their lives are cursed. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੇਗਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag saas saas man a(n)tar tat begal saran pareejai ||
lines.translation: As long as the breath breathes through the mind deep within, hurry and seek God's Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kripaa kripaa kar dhaarahu mai saadhoo charan pakheejai ||8||4||
lines.translation: Please shower Your Kind Mercy and take pity upon Nanak, that he may wash the feet of the Holy. ||8||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਧੁਵੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamaa mai saadhoo charan dhuveejai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I wash the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਹਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kilabikh dahan hohi khin a(n)tar mere thaakur kirapaa keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: May my sins be burnt away in an instant; O my Lord and Master, please bless me with Your Mercy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ ਖਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਅਤਿ ਤਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)gat jan deen khare dar thaadhe at tarasan kau daan deejai ||
lines.translation: The meek and humble beggars stand begging at Your Door. Please be generous and give to those who are yearning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: traahi traahi saran prabh aae mo kau guramat naam driReejai ||1||
lines.translation: Save me, save me, O God - I have come to Your Sanctuary. Please implant the Guru's Teachings, and the Naam within me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜੂਝੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam karodh nagar mahi sabalaa nit uth uth joojh kareejai ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the body-village; I rise up to fight the battle against them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)geekaar karahu rakh levahu gur pooraa kaadh kadheejai ||2||
lines.translation: Please make me Your Own and save me; through the Perfect Guru, I drive them out. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਬਲ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਹਿਵ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar agan sabal at bikhiaa hiv seetal sabad gur deejai ||
lines.translation: The powerful fire of corruption is raging violently within; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the ice water which cools and soothes.
